translations.web: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are Yahweh our God.
translations.bsb: “Return, O faithless children, and I will heal your faithlessness.” “Here we are. We come to You, for You are the LORD our God.
translations.kjv: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the LORD our God.
translations.asv: Return, ye backsliding children, I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we are come unto thee; for thou art Jehovah our God.
